name: Qalarc App Hub
lineage: README still documents an earlier 'deep-navy background, violet gradient accents' aesthetic; the current skin is Gruvbox dark — navy survives only as the rgba(10,11,30,.7) glass topbar tint
signature: 2x2 brand glyph tile in a yellow-to-orange gradient with glow box-shadow, layered radial yellow/orange washes over a gruvbox-dark gradient background, blurred glass topbar, 232px category sidebar with live status dots
description: Gruvbox-dark launcher/marketplace dashboard: rounded cards on a warm dark gradient with yellow/orange radial glows, glass topbar, collapsible category sidebar, density toggle and a terminal-style build-log panel.

name: Local Media Studio — Amber CRT Boot
lineage: Canonical implementation of the shared fivelidz retro-terminal tokens (SHARED_DESIGN.md); full themeable UI lives at ../ui/static (served by backend :8931) after the 2026-07-20 'legible pass' — prior retro theme archived as style_*_pre_legible.css
signature: ASCII block-font banner in a box-drawn frame, striped phosphor progress bar, scanline + vignette overlays, blinking block cursor, '> '-prefixed uppercase status line
description: Phosphor-amber CRT boot screen for the Tauri shell: ASCII banner, segmented progress bar and scanline/vignette FX while polling the local backend; the full themeable studio UI (amber/green/gruvbox/synthwave) loads once the backend on :8931 is up.

name: Tulpa Studio — Phosphor Terminal
lineage: Skin replicated 1:1 from Local Media Studio ('STYLEBENCH — RETRO CRT / TERMINAL SKIN' v0.3.0 'phosphor pass'); adds a 5th monokai palette; /home/fivelidz/projects/tauri_apps/tulpa_studio is a symlink to this repo (not a distinct app)
signature: Raised panel legends overhanging panel borders by 8px, box-drawn ASCII banner + status strip, dense statusline with service dots, 5 switchable phosphor palettes (amber/green/gruvbox/synthwave/monokai), glow reserved for the banner only
description: Persona-conversation studio in the shared retro-terminal skin: dense sunken panels with raised legends, monospace data readouts over legible Roboto body text, amber by default with green/gruvbox/synthwave/monokai themes via data-theme.

name: fivelidz Retro-Terminal Design System
lineage: Documented standard in SHARED_DESIGN.md: Local Media Studio implements the full themeable version, Tulpa Studio replicates it 1:1 (+monokai); apps later added a 'legible pass' (Roboto body text) softening the mono-everywhere rule; Qalarc App Hub opts out with its own gruvbox launcher skin
signature: 0px border-radius, 1px solid phosphor borders, sunken panels, box-drawing chars for frames/gauges (┌─┐ ▰▱ █▓▒░), buttons as bracketed terminal labels [ RUN ]/[F1], toggleable CRT FX (scanlines + glow + vignette), uppercase letter-spaced headers
description: Shared design tokens for fivelidz Tauri apps: a monospace retro-terminal language with four themeable palettes (amber-crt default, green-phosphor, gruvbox, synthwave) switched via data-theme on <body> and persisted in localStorage.
